function.name: check_nearby_reports
function.description: Searches the database for active reports within 50 meters.

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Returns current conditions and rain forecast for a GPS coordinate.

function.name: get_traffic
function.description: Returns travel time and congestion level from depot to defect.

function.name: geocode_location
function.description: Converts a user-provided address or place name into GPS coordinates.

function.name: reverse_geocode
function.description: Takes GPS coordinates and returns the full address, road name, and road classification.

function.name: check_historical_failure
function.description: Checks database for previous reports within 100m. Returns true if repeat failure.

function.name: find_nearby_infrastructure
function.description: Scans for nearby schools or hospitals within 150m to dynamically adjust urgency.

function.name: send_user_prompt
function.description: Sends a message to the user asking for missing info (e.g., exact location).

message.description: The exact message to send to the user

function.name: lookup_jurisdiction_contact
function.description: Looks up the responsible authority and their contact email based on district and road type.

road_type.description: The classification of the road: 'Federal', 'State', or 'Municipal'

function.name: dispatch_work_order
function.description: Sends an official email work order to the assigned government contractor or authority.

dispatch_email.description: The target email address for the authority

assigned_authority.description: Name of the authority (e.g., JKR Federal)
